paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism
caption: : Agency A
model_annotation: The donut chart, titled "Stimuli Type," displays the distribution of different types of stimuli used in Agency A, as part of a study on generative AI's use in journalism. The chart is divided into eight segments, each representing a distinct stimuli type with its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored dark red, is "Draft/Other" at 28.5%. Following this, "Press Release" accounts for 21.9% and is shown in gold. "External News Article" makes up 13.1% and is depicted in dark green. "Interview" represents 10.2% and is colored dark blue. Both "Organizational Report" and "Event Posting" are tied at 8.8%, shown in purple and light purple, respectively. "Organizational Website" comprises 6.6% and is displayed in light blue. The smallest segment, "Social Media Post," is 1.5% and appears in light green. The smallest slice, "Intra-agency news article," is 0.7% and is shown in a very thin orange segment. Each segment is labeled with its category and percentage, and the chart is arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top right. The center of the donut chart contains the title "Stimuli Type" in bold black text.
